newsitem.title: USA: Asahi/America sees lower Q1 shr.
newsitem.headline: Asahi/America sees lower Q1 shr.

text.p: Asahi/America Inc said Tuesday it expected net earnings for its first quarter to be lower than those a year ago due to lower sales and higher expenses.
The company said it expected to report about $0.11 per share for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 against $0.22 last year when it released its results on April 29.
It said it would also report revenues totaling between about $9.1 million to $9.6 million.

"Increased operating expenses coupled with a slowdown in dual containment sales to the military and semiconductor marketplace caused revenue and earnings results to fall somewhat below expectations," it said.

"However, the first quarter in the past has traditionally been seasonally slower," it said. "And it should be noted that first quarter 1996 results were favorably impacted by a large dual containment military base piping project, coupled with a significantly lower share count making the comparison between the two periods more difficult."
Asahi/America makes thermoplastic valves, piping systems and components.
